<SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
The plan is to send the confirmation email as requested by Alison.
Alison has confirmed that Thursday at 14:30 works for all four partners and she is booking it.
My part of the task is to send the confirmation email.
I will use the `send_confirmation_email` function.
The email should state that the meeting is for 30 minutes on Thursday, November 19, at 14:30.
I'll write a simple and clear email body.
After sending the email, I'll end my session.This is a confirmation that the partners' meeting has been scheduled for Thursday, November 19, at 14:30 Eastern for 30 minutes.
